title: Small interval probability for a linear form
statement: Let $a_1,\ldots,a_n$ be real numbers with $\sum_{i=1}^n a_i^2=1$ and $|a_i|\le\delta$ for every $i$, and let $t\ge0$. For a uniformly chosen sign vector $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, the probability that $\left|\sum_{i=1}^n a_i x_i\right|\le t$ is at most $2t+2C\delta$, where $C$ is the third-moment Berry–Esseen constant.
hypotheses_covered: Each coefficient has absolute value at most $\delta$
